title: 536–542 AD darkness and cooling linked to volcanism or comet debris

tellings.quote: Uh the years 536 to 542 AD were periods where, you know, the the the the the records of the monks and the the people who were living through that time talk about weeks and months at a time when they couldn't see the sun.

plain: Between 536 and 542 AD, the records of monks and others living in Europe at the time describe weeks and months on end when they could not see the sun, a darkness and cooling that some link to volcanoes or to debris from a comet. The researcher Randall Carlson tells Michels this, summarising those old records without naming a particular one, as a sign that catastrophes from the sky have shaped human history.
